reviewer_issue: Pseudo-swarm is not real swarm validation
allowed_wording: VisDrone is single-camera real-detector validation; controlled replay is a track-initiation extension.
forbidden_wording: Validated real UAV swarm; replacement for synchronized multi-UAV datasets.
notes: No new multi-UAV dataset was added by design.

reviewer_issue: F1 gain is small; task should focus on false-new tracks
allowed_wording: The trust layer reduces false-new tracks with bounded F1 loss; matched-cleanliness comparisons are primary.
forbidden_wording: The method improves overall tracking F1.
notes: YOLOv8s ByteTrack trust point reduces false-new tracks from 6838 to 4799.

reviewer_issue: Confidence threshold may explain the effect
allowed_wording: At comparable false-new counts, trust preserves more F1 than the tested fixed confidence threshold.
forbidden_wording: Trust universally dominates all confidence thresholds.
notes: The closest-cleanliness threshold 0.2 has lower F1 than the trust point.

reviewer_issue: Bayesian filter dominates the selected trust point
allowed_wording: Bayesian existence is the stronger numerical baseline in controlled replay; trust remains interpretable/no-label.
forbidden_wording: Bayesian requires a learned model; trust beats simple fusion baselines.
notes: The generated claim-safe note explicitly records Bayesian dominance.

reviewer_issue: Simple fusion baselines are not cooperative perception SOTA
allowed_wording: Simple fusion rules are track-confirmation references, not CoBEVFusion/V2X-Real analogues.
forbidden_wording: Simple fusion baselines represent cooperative perception SOTA.
notes: Full cooperative perception remains future work.

reviewer_issue: Min-rule guarantee does not cover temporal recovery
allowed_wording: Strict mode is noncompensatory; balanced mode uses temporal recovery and weakens the guarantee.
forbidden_wording: The complete deployed decision rule is fully noncompensatory.
notes: Article text must keep strict and balanced modes separate.

allowed_wording: Geometry/temporal channels are the main practical contributors; kinematic support is not claimed as dominant.
forbidden_wording: Each channel independently improves the result.
notes: The safe claim is feature-set trade-off, not guaranteed marginal utility for every channel.

reviewer_issue: Label scarcity does not prove the niche by F1 alone
allowed_wording: Low-label/stale-calibration niche is reported with caveats and supporting diagnostics.
forbidden_wording: Trust is better than RF under all label budgets.
notes: Use calibration staleness/transfer evidence where available; do not overread label-scarcity F1.

reviewer_issue: Need map-contamination metrics, not only false-new count
allowed_wording: Report observed false-track occupancy and initiation precision as map-contamination proxies.
forbidden_wording: Full tracker lifecycle occupancy is measured if only observed-row proxy exists.
notes: Current occupancy is an observed-detection-row proxy unless a lifecycle table is available.

reviewer_issue: Failure-case subgroup F1 is not standard object-level F1
forbidden_wording: Subgroup diagnostics are standard object-level F1 or speed robustness.
notes: Motion proxy was replaced with tracklet-persistence bins.

reviewer_issue: Five seeds are not independent scene repeats
allowed_wording: Repeated seeds are deterministic confidence-perturbation trials, not independent scenes.
forbidden_wording: Five seeds prove independent simulation reproducibility.

allowed_wording: Use the code-level contract and strict/balanced terminology for the algorithm description.
forbidden_wording: Q=min(c,k,s) alone describes the full implementation.
notes: A paper pseudocode block still needs to be aligned with the code.

allowed_wording: Runtime is implementation-dependent; vectorized aggregation is a microbenchmark over prepared features.
forbidden_wording: 5 ms/frame is generally acceptable for UAV deployment.
notes: Full detector/tracker runtime is not benchmarked here.

allowed_wording: The bundle provides scripts, selected outputs, manifest/checksum references, and claim-safe notes.
forbidden_wording: The bundle alone contains raw images, detector JSON, and all external dependencies.
notes: Heavy inputs remain outside the slim bundle.
